overall_reason: The page chose stillness: none of the 164 visible elements declares a transition or animation, the stylesheet has no @keyframes, and the one measured trigger (the "Search Design System" input) changed state with no movement, which suits a documentation site visitors read and return to.
strengths: No motion at all: the declared table lists 0 transitioning elements, 0 running animations and 0 @keyframes, so the hero, "What's new" and nav arrive with the page and nothing waits on an animation.
The search input answers its click instantly (no animation, no live movement), the right timing for a control used on every visit.
not_investigated: No motion to judge: every measured change was instant and no element declares a transition or animation.
Passive motion: no passive recording, though the stylesheet holds no keyframes that could play.
T-ENTER-EXIT, T-SPATIAL-MEANING, T-CONTINUITY, T-POSTER and T-DEMO-LOOP: no element opens with motion and there is no demo.

Interruptibility and rapid toggles (T-RAPID-TOGGLE): no detector built. Gestures, scroll-driven motion (the capture does not scroll while recording), hover as it plays and route transitions were not captured.
